reviews.review: A little on the short side as I finished the game in 8 hours. However I still recommend you give it a go. Worth every penny :)
Good solid fun for the occasional heresy expulsion

Outstanding. I went into this game expecting something very close to Gears of War. It's WAY MORE free flowing than GOW. The combat is gritty, visceral, and fast paced. The story is interesting and deep but not imposing. Simply put, this game is an obscene amount of fun. 

Here's a video of me reviewing it whilst giggling like an idiot:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W685AtJJACQ

Urgh, I played this today for the first time in a quite a while and now understand why I stopped playing in the first place, because it has the *absolute worst* control system of any game ever ever made (and that's some feat). 

Personally I find the movement and combat clunky as all hell, the targeting reticle for guns is overly large and mostly pointless, plus I find it hinders more than it helps when aiming at enemies at mid-to-long range because it just blocks the things you're aiming at. 

The melee attacks are slow and cumbersome and when fighting multiple enemies the slow execution of the melee combos is basically just a death-sentance because your combos will get interupted before you can perform an execution and so you will likely die before killing any of them.

It seems like the developers wanted to capture the sluggishness of wearing power armour, which has been done pretty well, but from a gameplay perspective they have added no positive empowerment to offset the negative. i.e. the have restricted player maneuverability and in return you get...jack all - you can't take advantange of cover and peek-out to shoot like in similar games (Gears of War etc) but strangely you can combat roll which is not nearly as helpful though.

Altogether these things make the game very frustrating and I don't think the game could feel more disjointed if it tried. So if you are considering purchasing this game just to get a Space Marine fix, there are probably other games to better spend money on to be honest.
